mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.description, t.coverUrl, t.category, t.curatorId, t.updateSchedule, t.isFeatured, t.createTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_picture tp JOIN picture p ON p.id = tp.pictureId AND p.isDelete = 0 AND p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.reviewStatus = 1 WHERE tp.topicId = t.id) AS pictureCount FROM topic t WHERE t.isDelete = 0
AND t.category = #{category}
AND t.isFeatured = 1
ORDER BY t.isFeatured DESC, t.createTime DESC

SELECT p.id, p.url, p.thumbnailUrl, p.name, p.category, p.tags, p.picSize, p.picWidth, p.picHeight, p.picScale, p.picFormat, p.mainColor, p.colorFamily, p.downloadCount, p.collectCount, p.userId, p.spaceId, p.createTime FROM topic_picture tp JOIN picture p ON p.id = tp.pictureId WHERE tp.topicId = #{topicId} AND p.isDelete = 0 AND p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.reviewStatus = 1 ORDER BY tp.createTime DESC, tp.id DESC
